title: Figure 7: Graphs of Relative Angular Position and Relative Angular Velocity, "Utah" film
description: Hand-drawn curves on Douglas Aircraft Company graph paper, rotated sideways: a "Graph of Relative Angular Position" in radians and a "Graph of Relative Angular Velocity" in radians/second, both plotted against time in seconds (about 0 to 17). The form header reads "Photogrammetric Analysis of 'Utah' Film," prepared by R.M.L. Baker Jr., dated April 8, 1956, Report No. 02, page 13.
